cases.user_message:
Отсканировал письмо от поставщика, распознал, текст ниже (там местами кривое распознавание). Мне надо вставить это в следующий промпт, где модель будет сверять условия со счётом, а место там ограничено. Сделай так, чтобы осталось только то, что реально нужно для сверки, но ничего важного не потерялось.

---
Уважаемый Алексей Викторович!
Прежде всего хотим поблагодарить Вас за многолетнее и плодотворное сотрудничество, которое мы очень ценим. Как Вы, вероятно, знаете, ситуация на рынке в последнее время непростая, и мы, к сожалению, вынуждены пересмотреть ряд условий.
В связи с этим сообщаем, что с 01.11.2026 цена на гофрокороб Т-23 (арт. ГК-2340) составит 41,70 руб./шт. без НДС (ранее 38,90 руб./шт.). Цена на гофрокороб Т-24 (арт. ГК-2410) остаётся без изменений — 52,30 руб./шт. без НДС.
При этом, как и раньше, мы готовы предоставить скидку 3 % от суммы счёта при условии оплаты в течение 5 (пяти) банковских дней с даты счёта. Обращаем внимание, что скидка не распространяется на заказы менее 2 000 шт. в одной позиции.
Минимальная партия по-прежнему составляет 1 000 шт. на позицию. Срок поставки — 7 рабочих днеи с момента подтверждения заказа, для заказов свыше 20 000 шт. — 12 рабочих дней.
Заказы, подтверждённые до 31.10.2026 включительно, будут отгружены по старым ценам при условии их полной оплаты до 07.11.2026.
Ещё раз повторим, что новая цена на Т-23 — 41,70 руб./шт. без НДС — вступает в силу с 01.11.2026.
Мы искренне надеемся на понимание и дальнейшее взаимовыгодное сотрудничество. Будем рады ответить на любые вопросы.
С уважением,
коммерческий директор ООО «ПакТрейд» Смирнова Е.А.
тел. +7 (495) 123-45-67
P.S. В нашем предварительном письме от 15.10.2026 ошибочно был указан срок оплаты до 05.11.2026 — правильно до 07.11.2026, как указано выше.
---
cases.why_in_scope: The implant makes the model distill the letter into atomic, verifiable facts: every price, article, date and threshold, plus the logical conditions (discount only if paid within 5 banking days and not for lines under 2,000 pcs; old prices only if confirmed by 31.10 and fully paid by 07.11), while stripping courtesy text and the repeated T-23 sentence. A strong model without it tends to write a smooth prose summary that merges or drops a condition (e.g. states 'old prices for orders before 31.10' without the payment deadline, or omits the 2,000-pc discount exclusion), which is exactly what breaks the downstream invoice check. The P.S. adds a superseded date (05.11.2026) that a faithful condensation must not carry forward as a live term.
rubric: Keeps all numeric terms correctly: T-23 (ГК-2340) 41,70 руб./шт. без НДС from 01.11.2026 (was 38,90); T-24 (ГК-2410) unchanged at 52,30 руб./шт. без НДС; minimum 1 000 pcs per line; delivery 7 working days, 12 for orders over 20 000 pcs.

Preserves both conditions in full: the 3% discount requires payment within 5 banking days of the invoice date and does not apply to lines under 2 000 pcs; old prices apply only to orders confirmed by 31.10.2026 inclusive AND fully paid by 07.11.2026.
Drops the greetings, market-situation justification, repeated T-23 price sentence and closing pleasantries, and presents the result as separate short one-fact items rather than paragraphs.
Adds no terms that are not in the letter (no invented VAT rate, penalties or payment deadlines) and does not present the superseded 05.11.2026 date as a current deadline.

cases.user_message:
Here's what came out of OCR on my handwritten notes from yesterday's vendor call (scanned from a notebook, so it's messy and I rambled). I need to paste this into an agent that drafts our follow-up email, and it chokes on long inputs. Boil it down for me, but it has to stay accurate.

---
Call w/ Northwind Displays, Sep 24, ~45 min, me + Tom (finance) + Priya (ops). Their side: Dana Kessler (acct mgr).
Started w/ small talk, Dana just back from vacation, weather etc.
Main topic = the kiosk screens order. We need 120 units for the store rollout. Dana said lead time is normally 6 wks but they can do 4 wks if we confirm by Oct 2.
Budget: I said 42k but Tom corrected me — approved budget is 48k incl shipping. Dana's quote was $395/unit + $1,900 shipping -> 120 x 395 = 47,400 + 1,900 = 49,300, so we're over by 1,300.
Dana said she might be able to do 3% off if we sign a 2-yr service contract — she'll check w/ her manager and get back by Friday Sep 27. Not confirmed!!
Priya: first 40 units must hit the Denver warehouse before Nov 1 bc that's when the pilot stores open. Rest (80) can come later, by Dec 1.
If Northwind can't commit to Nov 1 for the first 40 -> we go w/ backup vendor (Brightline), Priya already has their quote.
Again: first 40 by Nov 1 is the hard requirement.
Tom wants net-30 payment terms, Dana thinks net-30 is fine but has to confirm in writing.
Action items: Dana -> discount answer by Fri 9/27 + written confirm on net-30. Me -> send follow-up email recapping all this. Priya -> share Denver delivery address w/ Dana.
Wrapped up, Dana mentioned their holiday party lol.
---
cases.why_in_scope: The implant pushes the model to extract atomic facts with numbers, names, dates, causal links and conditions while dropping chit-chat and repetition. The traps are the self-correction (budget is $48k, not $42k), the unconfirmed and conditional discount (only with a 2-year service contract, pending Dana's manager), the conditional switch to Brightline if Northwind can't commit to Nov 1, and the 4-week lead time that depends on confirming by Oct 2. A strong model writing a narrative recap can easily carry the $42k figure, present the 3% discount as agreed, or flatten the conditions.
rubric: States the approved budget as $48k including shipping (not $42k), the quote as $395/unit plus $1,900 shipping totalling $49,300, and the $1,300 overage.

Keeps the conditions and uncertainty intact: 4-week lead time only if confirmed by Oct 2 (otherwise 6 weeks); 3% discount is unconfirmed and tied to a 2-year service contract, answer due Fri Sep 27; net-30 not yet confirmed in writing; switch to Brightline if Northwind can't commit to the first 40 units in Denver by Nov 1.
Keeps the delivery split (40 units to Denver by Nov 1, remaining 80 by Dec 1) and the action items with their owners (Dana, the user, Priya).
Omits small talk (vacation, weather, holiday party) and the repeated Nov 1 line, giving short one-fact items rather than a prose paragraph.

checker_notes: Verified all numbers and arithmetic (120x$395+$1,900=$49,300, $1,300 over $48k). Case 1 was likely too easy for a strong model, so added a P.S. with a superseded 05.11.2026 payment date as a trap and extended rubric item 4 to penalise carrying it forward; case 2 kept as is.
